avis.texte: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I used to dislike sheet masks since I despised the slime-y feel/texture but that has changed due to my many travels. I still preferred masks in containers but it sure does make it easier traveling with sheet masks! Anyway, since I’ve been on the hunt for the best Korean sheet masks - I’ve ordered anything and everything under the sun with suitable ingredients for my combination skin. In addition, I also know what ingredients I’d like to omit. These Medicube salmon PDRN masks made the list and during my current travel, I immediately put them to the test. Honestly, I was not expecting much but I gotta say in just this initial test - I’m kind of sold. My skin looked instantly glowy and my pores looked drastically diminished, despite a night of heavy drinking and lack of sleep. In addition, I was even more thrilled it didn’t cause breakouts and/or irritations. I dig how the sheet mask adhered to my face properly without being too small or too large and stuck to the skin well. I used the remainder of the mask on parts of my body where I’d like to combat dryness such as elbows, hands, stomach, legs and thighs. I’m trying to un-program my mind thinking a sheet mask’s essence is only suitable to be used on face/neck and not other areas. It’s wickedly good ingredients in them and why shouldn’t we? Give the best to all parts of yourself! It’s what I call proper self-care. Anyway, Medicube products can be a hit or miss for me but these sheet mas

My girls bought me the Medicube Salmon DNA PDRN masks, and I honestly didn’t know what to expect—but wow, what a difference they made on my mature skin. After just one use, my skin felt deeply hydrated, smoother, and looked much more refreshed. Fine lines appeared softer, and my face had a healthy glow that I haven’t seen in a while. Mature skin can sometimes feel dull or tired, but these masks gave me a noticeable boost in brightness and elasticity. They were also gentle, soothing, and didn’t irritate my skin at all. I highly recommended giving these a try, Medicube products are now a part of my daily skincare routine. Everyone comments on my skin now and how I don’t look my age.

avis.titre: One of the better sheets masks on the market
avis.texte: As with all skincare products, I tried out these masks for six months before writing this review. I used the mask once a week and applied the extra serum left in the pouch 2-3 days during the week. I’ve made the mistake of keeping the mask on for too long (until it was completely dried out) thinking longer is better. NOT SO! It made creases (temporary) on my skin. Now, I take it off promptly after 15 minutes even if the mask still fits damp/sticky. I usually use the mask in the evening before going to bed and i can definitely see a difference in the morning. My skin is more glowy, more plump, and healthier looking. Dare I say I “look” a bit prettier? That, unfortunately, does not last for more than a few hours. But it does make my foundation look more flawless (I use Jung Saem Mool’s Nuder Cushion) I am not sure if PDRN is supposed to help with hyperpigmentation/discoloration, but it has not made a difference in fading my old acne scars. The few negatives: the plastic sheet the mask is wrapped in is not necessary. It merely adds to more environmental waste. Also, the fit is not consistent. The size of openings for eyes, etc are different for each mask.
Moisturizing! This is a good quick face mask! Doesn’t leave me feeling sticky like I’ve experienced with other masks.

I like this face mask a lot. It only takes about 20 minutes, and after, my face looked and felt a lot better. I had some redness from too much time in the sun, and this face mask did a lot to help alleviate that. It left my face feeling hydrated and looking smoother. avis.titre: The best facemask I ever used!
avis.texte: I have used countless facemasks and this one is my favorite! I might be biased because I have a slight obsession with PDRN products because they make such a big difference in my skin, besides retinol, this is my all-time favorite ingredient! Medicube never disappoints, I have so many of their products and they all work really well with my very sensitive skin, I’m more than happy to pay a bit extra for these high-quality products.

I love Medicube products, especially the PDRN Pink One Day Serum is my favorite product in their PDRN line. I really wanted to love this mask, but it’s just okay for me like any other mask, not a “wow” like the one day serum. There’s nothing wrong with the mask; it’s just not a Medicube standout for me. The pack contains 10 individually wrapped masks, great for travel. To use, open the packet, unfold the mask, remove and discard the white plastic backing, and apply the pink mask to your face. It has a slight chemical scent—not strong or unpleasant, but to me it’s not floral or herbal. The mask is soaked in serum and since this mask it so thin it feels more like paper but wouldn't rip on you (’cause it's woven fiber), making it a bit tricky to separate from the plastic. Once applied, it stays smooth, and you can relax or go about your day for about 20 minutes. I pat the extra serum from the packet onto my neck and chest, then continue my skincare routine after it dries. My skin does feels hydrated and supple afterward and I like that it contains salmon PDRN and other skincare ingredients, but I’d rather repurchase the PDRN Pink One Day Serum than another sheet mask pack.

-You get 10 pieces of Sheet Mask and they are made in Korea -Each mask comes with a white plastic layer which you remove before using -I use this on my clean face after shower for about 20 minutes until it dries up -This pink colored Sheet Mask contains a strong flowery scent, but I wish it is scentless -It is hydrating and the remaining essence is enough for my whole body
